name: the header guard checks data-col-name only
why: The original defect: a header rebuilt from a file has no data-col-name, so the pair is injected again and every later column shifts.

name: the cell identity is not saved
why: _buildDiskCellData() drops recof/mbid/recofState, so a reloaded cell is a bare <td>.

name: the cell identity is not restored
why: _recOfRestoreCell() does nothing, so the loaded answer reads as never loaded and no row can be loaded.

name: a file without the cells still gets the columns
why: The legacy check is gone: a file saved before the feature gains two headers but no cells.
